fields.label: M3 librw lane
fields.value: I4 FOG CLOSED 2026-08-02 (b31baba9), new librw patch P6. Fog here is NOT fixed-function -- it is a vertex-shader constant whose end beginUpdate happens to populate from cam->farPlane, under an upstream TODO. setFogRange() decouples it after beginUpdate; the far plane is deliberately NOT shortened (it would rewrite the depth values librw writes into the buffer it SHARES with the D3D9 path). Measured with an env-gated same-binary control (MASHED_LIBRW_FOGFIX=0) that reproduces the prior numbers to the hundredth on 6/7 shots: world-only 0.39-0.93 -> 0.04-0.45, instanced 0.41-7.88 -> 0.06-7.12, 7/7 improved. Default D3D9 path still 0.00. ALSO: the fog hypothesis for the instanced SEA is DISPROVED (closing the ramp moved it the wrong way, 1.52x->1.58x; more fog can only brighten toward fog colour 24,28,40 which is brighter than the 11.1,17.8,20.7 baseline) -- its 1.5x is an unidentified open cause. NEAREST/LINEAR delta measured at 0.00 (Arctic TXD already LINEAR; non-degeneracy control run). World-only residual itemised: NOT diffuse -- 43/48 cells exactly 0.0, whole lower half bit-identical, residual is one horizon object (mip explanation disproved, both uploaders single-level). INSTANCED PROPS/CARS NOW ON BY DEFAULT (fdfba4eb). D-S3-SEA was root-caused (f60603a7) and FIXED: the librw path applied NO UV ANIMATION -- static UVs while D3D9 scrolled them per frame. Found by POSITIVE CONTROL (MASHED_NO_UVSCROLL=1 reproduced the defect on the shipping renderer, closing 97% of the gap); ruled out en route with evidence: the bake (vertex colours BIT-IDENTICAL at (62,91,89)), ambient quantisation, ambient double-count, texture decode incl. the PAL4 nibble trap, alpha blending, filtering, fog. Fix moves the texture coordinates themselves (librw's shader pipe has no texture matrix; its UVAnim plugin is stream-only) -- NO new librw patch, vendored snapshot untouched. Verified 3 ways on one binary: A) no env = shipping D3D9, 0.00 on all 7; B) MASHED_RENDER_LIBRW=1 = 0.06-0.59, sea ratio 1.02/1.00/0.99; C) +MASHED_LIBRW_INST=0 reverts to 0.04-0.45. B reproduced the prior explicit-INST run to the hundredth. Instanced path now at or below world-only on 4 of 7 shots.
